subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, Gateway `agent`, bootstrap-aware prompts, and model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing surface while current main intentionally documents and tests acknowledgement-only resets, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep Ack Default With Opt-In Greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped cheap reset acknowledgement as the default and expose an explicit mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and wait for maintainer sponsorship before adding reset greeting or model-routing config.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history around the shipped acknowledgement branch and prior reset-contract review.
